data.title: Harbour Lights
data.about:
Damac Properties’ Harbour Lights, where luxury takes centre stage. Immerse yourself in a world of entrancing allure, inspired by the sea’s enticing waves and mesmerising beauty. Prepare to be taken in by the sheer elegance and sophistication of this 52-story marvel, which features precisely constructed 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments along the magnificent waterfront. Indulge in a lifestyle reminiscent of a luxurious cruise ship. 

From the enormous, cabin-like rooms to the sprawling, resort-style swimming pools, every interior detail and facility symbolises the pinnacle of magnificence. At Harbour Lights by Damac, you’ll find yourself in a luxurious and exclusive environment where every detail radiates richness.

Enter a world where high-end luxury meets flawless fashion. The famous brand de Grisogono incorporates its unique style throughout the property’s common areas, resulting in a smooth flow of intriguing features that delicately guide you through this refuge of elegance. As you experience the mesmerising attractions of Harbour Lights by Damac Properties, prepare to be transported to a realm of unparalleled luxury. Discover a residential paradise where exclusivity meets sophistication, and let the harmonic blend of design and ambiance to leave an indelible mark on your senses. Set out on this remarkable journey to discover the pinnacle of luxury living.

characteristics_module.title: Enter a world where high-end luxury meets flawless fashion
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Price starting from AED 2.6M
  • Gorgeous 1, 2 and 3 Bedroom seaside apartments
  • 70/30 Payment Plan
  • Branded residences by De Grisogono
  • Endless ocean views
  • Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road
  • Floating Pool
  • Luxury food and beverage options
  • 52 storey apartments
  • Located in a maritime hub

location_tile.title: Nestled in a prime location between Port Rashid and Dubai’s Drydocks World
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description: Harbour Lights at Dubai Maritime City, is located between Port Rashid and Dubai’s Drydocks World, strategically leverages its ideal location to create a thriving hub that connects the maritime industry. This vibrant destination not only caters to maritime professionals, but also offers residents an interesting and urban lifestyle that feeds on the energy of the city.
